sources.label: Wikipedia, "Celaeno (star)"
sources.quote: Celaeno, designated 16 Tauri, is a star in the constellation of Taurus and a member of the Pleiades open star cluster (M45) of stars.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 3.4 solar radii and 3.36 solar masses (FLAME) and 11,577 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
